blurb: Salt Devil Tritoon Cruises specializes in private, luxury cruises where you aren’t packed in with strangers. Get swept away with our 1 1/2 hour cruises. We will make your day special whether it’s sight seeing, enjoying cocktails, birthdays, proposals or renewing your vows. We also offer proper burials at sea. Salt Devil offers an intimate, unique journey around historical Port Aransas. Create an unforgettable moment
